description: This file defines interfaces and classes for message output and publishing in a C++ project, including console, syslog, file, JSON, UDP, and WebSocket outputs, as well as an IPublish interface and related data structures.

classes.name: IPublish
classes.description: Interface for publishing messages, with a virtual Message method.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class for converting message info and text into a formatted string.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to the console.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to syslog.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that writes messages to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Class for formatting message data as JSON, with configurable output options.

classes.name: JSON::Data
classes.description: JSON container class holding message metadata fields.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that sends messages over UDP.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that manages WebSocket connections and exports message data.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput::ExportCommand
classes.description: JSON container for WebSocket export command configuration.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput::Channel
classes.description: Represents a UDP socket channel for WebSocket output.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Virtual method in IPublish for sending a message with metadata and text.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method in Text class to convert message info and text into a formatted string.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in ConsoleOutput, SyslogOutput, FileOutput, UDPOutput, WebSocketOutput to publish messages.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of filename in output.

methods.name: LineNumber
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of line number in output.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of class name in output.

methods.name: Module
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of module info in output.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of category in output.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of callsign in output.

methods.name: Date
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control inclusion of date in output.

methods.name: Paused
methods.description: Getter and setter in JSON class to control paused state in output.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method in JSON class to convert message info and text into JSON data structure.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Method in Channel class to send data over UDP socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Method in Channel class to handle socket state changes.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in UDPOutput and WebSocketOutput to send messages.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to process incoming configuration commands.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to attach a new WebSocket client.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to detach a WebSocket client.

methods.name: MaxConnections
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to get maximum allowed WebSocket connections.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to get current configuration command object.
